Company information (as of 2026-02-18):
| Current ratio           | 0.94 |
| Retained earnings       | 21,891M |
| Current liabilities     | 9,428M |
| Current assets          | 8,827M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 36,034M |
| Total liabilities       | 50,185M |
| Total assets            | 86,783M |
| EBIT / operating income | 467M |
| Revenue                 | 5,013M |
Return ONLY this JSON object and nothing else: {{"decision": "<one label>", "confidence": <integer 1-5>, "rationale": "<=25 words"}}
